title: Bridging-mediated compaction of mitotic chromosomes.
authors: Forte, Giada; Boteva, Lora; Gilbert, Nick; Cook, Peter R; Marenduzzo, Davide
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子动力学模拟研究凝聚蛋白介导的有丝分裂染色体压缩，虽涉及蛋白质-DNA互作但非TF-DNA体系，且缺乏AI方法，仅部分相关。
abstract: Within living cells, chromosome shapes undergo a striking morphological transition, from loose and uncondensed fibers during interphase to compacted and cylindrical structures during mitosis. ATP driven loop extrusion performed by a specialized protein complex, condensin, has recently emerged as a key driver of this transition. However, while this mechanism can successfully recapitulate the compaction of chromatids during the early stages of mitosis, it cannot capture structures observed after prophase. Here we hypothesize that a condensin bridging activity plays an additional important role, and review evidence - obtained largely through molecular dynamics simulations - that, in combination with loop extrusion, it can generate compact metaphase cylinders. Additionally, the resulting model qualitatively explains the unusual elastic properties of mitotic chromosomes observed in micromanipulation experiments and provides insights into the role of condensins in the formation of abnormal chromosome structures associated with common fragile sites.
abstract_zh: 在活细胞内，染色体形态经历显著的形态转变，从间期松散且未凝聚的纤维转变为有丝分裂期紧凑且圆柱形的结构。由专门蛋白质复合物——凝缩蛋白 (condensin) 执行的ATP驱动环挤压 (loop extrusion)，近期已被视为这一转变的关键驱动因素。然而，尽管该机制能成功重现有丝分裂早期阶段染色单体的凝聚过程，却无法捕捉前中期之后观察到的结构。在此，我们假设凝缩蛋白的桥接活性 (bridging activity) 扮演了额外的重要角色，并回顾了主要通过分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟获得的证据，表明其与环挤压结合时，能生成紧凑的中期圆柱体。此外，所得模型定性地解释了微操作实验中观察到的有丝分裂染色体异常弹性性质，并为凝缩蛋白在常见脆性位点相关异常染色体结构形成中的作用提供了见解。
